Jama Masjid and Shahjahanabad

A two-hour heritage walk in Old Delhi

On request

Arranged for your group. Send your preferred dates, group size and location. We adapt the length, level and language, and prepare a quotation. The suggested group size is a guide, not a requirement.

Request on WhatsApp Request by email

No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you study the congregational mosque within Shah Jahan's urban capital.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Jama Masjid courtyard/exterior
  • Urdu Bazaar approaches
  • Dariba/adjacent lanes
  • City morphology wrap-up

How the time is spent

  1. Jama Masjid courtyard/exterior 25 min

    Read congregational architecture and Shah Jahan.

    You: study elevation

  2. Urdu Bazaar approaches 35 min

    Explore historical commerce and street morphology.

    You: map street patterns

  3. Dariba/adjacent lanes 35 min

    Interpret occupational histories without romanticisation.

    You: observe shop typologies

  4. City morphology wrap-up 25 min

    Relate mosque and market to urban plan.

    You: draw 3-block diagram

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Identify and interpret key features of Jama Masjid & Shahjahanabad using material evidence and a site map.
  • Study the congregational mosque within Shah Jahan's urban capital.
  • Distinguish directly visible fabric from reconstructed or debated historical claims.

You take away

Your annotated field card, sketches and notes.

Where
Old Delhi
For
Schools, colleges, the public and private groups
Length

When
Any day you choose. Early morning is best in the warmer months.

Language

Agreed with you. Smaller and larger groups are welcome.
Meeting point
Agreed with you. A map location is shared once the date is confirmed.
What to bring
Comfortable shoes, water and a hat. The ground is uneven in places.
Entry fees
Monument entry fees, where charged, are not included.
